_comment: Bauer MCP gateway config. TEMPLATE ONLY — copy to /data/company/mcp_servers.json on the volume and fill real values there. Never commit secrets to this file. Decisions: bauer-automate/claude-skills#903 and #933.
_secrets_note: The gateway forwards only the env vars named in orchestrator/mcp_gateway.py::_FORWARDED_ENV_VARS to the extensible-mcp child. MS365_*, ZOHO_* and GITHUB_* are NOT in that list, so $VAR interpolation will NOT resolve for them. Put literal values in the copy on /data (which is never committed) rather than editing _FORWARDED_ENV_VARS — that is an upstream file and editing it is a permanent merge tax.

m365_graph._status: VERIFIED — flags, presets and counts read from 3P-ms-365-mcp-server@70a54bc src/cli.ts, src/tool-categories.ts, src/auth.ts and src/endpoints.json
m365_graph._note: --org-mode is required for Teams tools. Pin a version rather than floating on latest for a production service; the fork exists so we control when upstream lands.
m365_graph._read_only: --read-only is a TOOL-SURFACE filter, not a runtime guard: dropped tools never appear in tools/list. It removes every non-GET endpoint, keeping 7 POST-shaped reads (get-schedule, find-meeting-times, search-query, copilot-retrieve, get-presences-by-user-id, get-mail-tips, get-onenote-notebook-from-web-url) plus the 4 utility tools. This is the belt under the read-scopes-first posture in claude-skills#933; the service account's scopes remain the actual boundary. COST: graph-batch is a POST carrying no readOnly flag, so this drops it too, and no flag keeps batching while dropping the other writes. Accepted for the engine. An interactive consumer that needs graph-batch runs without --read-only and relies on its own scopes.
m365_graph._sharepoint_exclusion: SharePoint routes to bauer-sharepoint's own MCP server, not here (operator ruling 2026-09-19, claude-skills#903). There is NO sharepoint preset to switch off: those 34 tools sit inside the work preset alongside Teams. --enabled-tools compiles as new RegExp(pattern, 'i') against toolName, so negative lookahead works. Verified: keeps 298 of 332 endpoint tools, zero SharePoint leaking. Not shell-quoted because args are exec'd directly, not through a shell.
m365_graph._pin_me: PIN_ME cannot be resolved by reading the fork: its package.json says version 0.0.0-development because semantic-release stamps the real version at publish time. Resolve with `npm view @softeria/ms-365-mcp-server versions` and pin explicitly.

zoho._status: UNVERIFIED — do not enable until confirmed
zoho._confirm: Zoho's MCP is a hosted remote endpoint (mcp.zoho.com). Unknown whether extensible-mcp (git+https://github.com/SenteLabsAI/extensible-mcp) accepts remote URL servers or stdio only — the shipped example shows stdio only, and that package was not inspected. If stdio only, a stdio-to-HTTP bridge is needed and the exact command must be confirmed before use rather than guessed.
zoho._covers: Zoho CRM, Books, Desk. Float Financial spend arrives already inside Books via zoho-float-sync, so Float needs no entry of its own.

github._confirm: Needed so the Executive can see open work; claude-skills CLAUDE.md makes labelled issues the tracker of record. Confirm the current official server invocation and transport before filling this in.
github._scope: Read-only to start, matching the propose-only posture in #933. Scope any token to issues on bauer-automate repos.

filters._comment: Upstream's deny patterns, kept verbatim. Do not narrow this list. The propose-only posture (#933) relies on the identity lacking write scopes, not on these patterns alone — but these are a useful second layer.
